name: bulu-browser
description: Drive a dedicated real Chrome browser through CDP: open pages, read structured snapshots, click, type, screenshot, inspect network requests. Login state and bookmarks persist in an isolated profile.

display.name: 布噜浏览器
display.description_zh: 用独立的真实 Chrome 浏览器操作网页：打开、读取、点击、输入、截图、抓接口。基于 CDP + Playwright，登录态与书签保存在专属 profile，重启后依然可用。
display.description_en: Drive a dedicated real Chrome browser: open pages, read structured snapshots, click, type, screenshot and inspect network traffic. Login state and bookmarks persist across restarts.
examples_zh: 打开这个网页看看，帮我总结页面内容
帮我把这个表单填一下并提交
把页面上这个接口最近的请求抓出来，我要看返回结构
截个图给我看当前页面长什么样
examples_en: Open this page and summarize what it says
Fill in and submit this form for me
Capture the recent network requests on this page
Take a screenshot of the current page
